
  // (type any)
  public class Type_any {
    var backref : AnyObject?
    var refcount : Int
    var p_type : Vx_Core.Type_type!
    var p_const : Vx_Core.Type_const!
    var p_msgblock : Vx_Core.Type_msgblock!
    var p_delta : Vx_Core.Type_delta!
    var p_isrun : Bool
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_any
  public static func v_constructor_any(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.Type_any()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_any
  public static func v_create_any(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_constructor_any()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_any(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_any
  public static func v_initialize_any(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    value.p_type = Vx_Core.t_any
    value.backref = value
  }

  // v_release_any
  public static func v_release_any(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_any {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.e_any
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_any
  public static func v_shutdown_any(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    value.backref = nil
    let type_msgblock : Vx_Core.Type_msgblock = value.p_msgblock
    if type_msgblock !== Vx_Core.e_msgblock {
      value.p_msgblock = Vx_Core.e_msgblock
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        type_msgblock.p_any)
    }
    let type_const : Vx_Core.Type_const = value.p_const
    if type_const !== Vx_Core.e_const {
      value.p_const = Vx_Core.e_const
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        type_const.p_any)
    }
    value.p_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_any
  public static func v_startup_any(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_any
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.e_any
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_any(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "any",
      "any",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
          "backref",
          Vx_Core.t_any),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
          "refcount",
          Vx_Core.t_intn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "type",
          Vx_Core.t_type),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "const",
          Vx_Core.t_const),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "msgblock",
          Vx_Core.t_msgblock),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "delta",
          Vx_Core.t_delta),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "isrun",
          Vx_Core.t_booleann)
      ])
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_any_from_type_backref
  public static func v_any_from_type_backref(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ backref : AnyObject
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_create_any()
    output.p_type = type_type
    output.backref = backref
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_any
  public static func v_cast_any(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_type(
      type_type)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_cast_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_type,
      type_any)
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_any
  public static func a_copy_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_copy_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // v_new_any
  public static func v_new_any(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_type(
      type_type)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_new_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_type,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // v_count_any
  public static func v_count_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Int {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : Int = Vx_Core.v_count_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any)
    return output
  }

  // v_get_keyn_any
  public static func v_get_keyn_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ keyn : String
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_keyn_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any,
      keyn)
    return output
  }

  // v_get_indexn_any
  public static func v_get_indexn_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ indexn : Int
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_get_indexn_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any,
      indexn)
    return output
  }

  // v_listany_any
  public static func v_listany_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : [Vx_Core.Type_any] = Vx_Core.v_listany_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any)
    return output
  }

  // v_listkey_any
  public static func v_listkey_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [String] {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : [String] = Vx_Core.v_listkey_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any)
    return output
  }

  // v_mapany_any
  public static func v_mapany_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] {
    let type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    let output : [String:Vx_Core.Type_any] = Vx_Core.v_mapany_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any)
    return output
  }

  // v_release_any
  public static func v_release_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    type_any.refcount -= 1
    if type_any.refcount <= 0 {
      if type_any.refcount < 0 {
        Vx_Core.v_log_stringn(
          "Error: Negative Refcount - " +
            Vx_Core.v_typenamen_from_any(
              type_any))
      }
      Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
        type_any)
    }
  }

  // v_reserve_any
  public static func v_reserve_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    type_any.refcount += 1
  }

  // v_shutdown_any
  public static func v_shutdown_any(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) {
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_generic_from_any(
      type_any)
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_from_generic(
      type_generic,
      type_any)
  }

  // f_any
  public static func f_any(
    _ type_type : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_new_any(
      type_type,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_any : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_constructor_type()
  public static let e_any : Vx_Core.Type_any = Vx_Core.v_constructor_any()
